# Marketing Brief (Canonical Good Fixture)

## Product
- **Name:** Notable
- **One-sentence description:** Privacy-first password manager for individuals and families ($4.99/mo).
- **Stage:** Early post-PMF (80 paying customers, $400 MRR).
- **Current paying customers:** 80 at $4.99/mo = $400 MRR.

## Business model
- **Classification:** B2C mobile / consumer subscription.
- **Pricing / monetization:** Freemium → $4.99/mo individual / $7.99/mo family.
- **Target ACV / AOV:** $60 annual LTV.
- **Sales cycle:** Self-serve, <30 days from install to paid.

## Customer
- **One-sentence ICP (provisional until ICP subskill runs):** Privacy-conscious iOS users 30-50 who already pay for premium apps and recently dealt with a credential-leak incident.
- **Geographic reach:** US, UK, Canada, Australia (English).

## Team & resources
- **Founder profile:** Technical (built custom crypto layer).
- **Team size & dedicated marketing capacity:** Solo founder + 5h/week marketing time.
- **Budget tier:** T1 ($300/mo currently).
- **Monthly marketing spend (current):** $300.

## Asymmetric advantages
- Founder existing audience: Medium (8K followers on X/Twitter — security-engineer community).
- Pre-existing partnerships: None.
- Viral product mechanic (K-factor potential): Low — family-sharing only.
- Local market dominance: N/A.
- Counter-positioning opportunity: Yes — 1Password / Dashlane are cloud-default; we are local-first.

## 90-day target outcome
First 500 paying customers ($2,500 MRR) via founder content + Apple Search Ads on competitor terms.

## Hard constraints
- **Time deadlines:** None.
- **Banned channels:** None.
- **Banned tools:** None.
- **Regulated domain triggers:** None for marketing (handles privacy-sensitive data but marketing is unrestricted).
- **Cash runway:** 14 months self-funded.

## Decision cards

### [DEC-001] Business model classification

**Decision:** B2C consumer subscription (mobile-first) at $4.99/mo individual.

**Why this:**
1. Mobile-first market is iOS-heavy; product is iOS-native.
2. $4.99/mo matches established competitor pricing while differentiating on privacy positioning.

**Why not the alternatives:**
- Free + ads: rejected due to privacy positioning conflict.
- One-time $49: rejected due to ongoing security maintenance need + recurring revenue model viability.

**Confidence:** High
**Evidence grade:** A (user-confirmed product spec).
**Source basis:** User-confirmed.

**Asset / channel / metric bindings:** All channel decisions downstream consume this DEC.

**Kill criterion:** If at 6 months MRR < $1,500 and CAC > $80, revisit pricing model.

**Reversal trigger:** Competitor pricing shifts >30% in either direction.

### [DEC-002] Stage and readiness

**Decision:** Early post-PMF with 80 paying customers. Proceed to readiness check.

**Confidence:** High
**Evidence grade:** A
**Source basis:** User-confirmed.

## What we are intentionally NOT doing in this brief
- Defining ICP, positioning, or channel mix — those come from dedicated subskills with their own evidence base.
- Recommending tactics — premature until readiness check + ICP + positioning run.
- Including taste-word product descriptions — instead capturing the founder's own language verbatim.
